execution.resource_scope: single offline process maximum RSS from getrusage; no PDE/operator/factor/KSP

legacy_generator.basis: Review V3 limited lookup found commit 4e7d6074 adding result JSON only; no associated generator source was bound

backgrounds.incident_plane_wave: legacy R5 incident plane wave extended through the substrate; its substrate values reproduce the metric but are not a substrate Maxwell solution
backgrounds.layered_fresnel: existing flat air/substrate Fresnel background used by P1/P4

method.coordinates: input coordinates and structured-mesh code coordinates are nm; xyz order; exp(i k·r), exp(-i omega t)
method.interpolant: Basix N1curl p6 moment interpolation followed by the run's finalized double-Floquet MPC homogenize/backsubstitution; no fit or projection factor
method.curl: independent UFL curl(E_FE) into DG6; analytic curl is the direct derivative of the named plane-wave components
method.attribution: d=E_G0-E_G1; d_b=I_G0 b-I_G1 b; no fitted coefficient or phase

incident_plane_wave.curl_source: direct UFL curl(E_FE) into DG6 for both saved field and I_h b
incident_plane_wave.l2_measure: volume in nm^3; each reported L2 norm therefore has its field unit multiplied by nm^(3/2)

layered_fresnel.curl_source: direct UFL curl(E_FE) into DG6 for both saved field and I_h b
layered_fresnel.l2_measure: volume in nm^3; each reported L2 norm therefore has its field unit multiplied by nm^(3/2)
